tasks.title: Resolve tree-sitter grammar callables for multi-grammar wheels
tasks.parallelism_notes: Module 1. The ONLY task touching no shared file — it changes treesitter.py exclusively, so it shares nothing with 2020-2023. Per spec 'Worktree Strategy' the feature still runs sequentially in one per-spec worktree, but this task is explicitly independently valuable, mergeable and revertable: if the rest of FEAT-396 stalls, land this alone (it fixes TypeScript AND PHP outlines for every existing user).

tasks.title: Claim the .svelte suffix for the JavaScript scanner
tasks.parallelism_notes: Module 2. Order-independent from TASK-2019 (different files), but both must precede TASK-2021. Not parallel: it edits javascript.py, which 2021/2022/2023 also edit, so a separate worktree would collide on merge.

tasks.title: <script> pre-extraction and lang-aware grammar selection
tasks.parallelism_notes: Module 3. Hard-sequential: lang-based grammar selection is inert until TASK-2019 makes get_parser('typescript') return a Parser, and .svelte files do not reach this scanner until TASK-2020 claims the suffix. Edits javascript.py outline().

tasks.title: Alias-aware import resolution (JsIndex, $lib, tsconfig paths)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Module 4. Spec declares the dependency as Module 2 only, so it is technically independent of TASK-2021 — but both edit javascript.py (2021 outline(), 2022 build_reference_index/resolve_import/_extract_imports), so running them in parallel worktrees would collide. Sequenced after 2021 in the per-spec worktree.

tasks.title: Honest mode reporting, integration tests, and docs
tasks.parallelism_notes: Module 5. Closing task: the integration tests exercise all four preceding modules end-to-end, and the mode tightening is only correct once TASK-2019 makes the TypeScript grammar actually load. Depends on everything by construction.
